rules.rows: A row holds from its game time until the next row of the same day; every day starts at 00:00. days omitted means daily.
rules.place: A places.json id, or a map.json door id for a home. edge_north and edge_west mean off the Hook (home across town, the bus, the station).
rules.walking_reach: Between two rows on the Hook the walk on map.json's walking graph at 1.4 m/s (1.1 m/s at 70 and over) is taken out of the end of the stay before it (the person sets off early enough to arrive at the row's time) and uses no more than three quarters of that stay, counted in game minutes at 2 real seconds a game minute (120 s a game hour). Checked in code: tools/wave2/build_people.py.
rules.from_off_the_hook: Arriving from off the Hook (edge_north, edge_west, the police station, the Infirmary, licensing, the Copper Row market), the person is placed out of sight at the nearest soft edge, bus stop or door and is not reach-checked: the bus, a bike or a lift in town are not simulated (chosen).
rules.hours: A customer act (breakfast, dinner, shopping, a frame) falls inside the place's public hours; a keeper or worker may be there before opening and after closing.
rules.finders: 2.5.5: whoever's routine next brings them past an unseen deed finds it; the named finders are listed in finders below.
